scope: Per-arm exact-remaining cash observations and financial exit consumers in the paired PAPER runner experiment. No change to live execution, active operator models, learned policies, environment or primary trade size.
implementation: Original research cash owner derives independently from the immutable case and policy arm. A research owner can consume only a mapping of its own financial generation; it cannot consume an actual SQL position. Original buy/SQL guards remain mandatory.

The actual runner tick now requests valuations for arms without a pending intent. Pending execution probes have priority. Oldest valuations are serviced next; exact matching token/raw quantities may share a returned quote, but each arm captures and checks its own cash, costs and original typed FX.

Raw market prices cannot create runner financial intents or peaks. Independent no-price time and checked liquidity-crush safeguards remain available. The existing price-bearing shared exit path uses the same extracted liquidity rule without changing its priority. Original market peaks are retained only as finite diagnostic values.

Remaining-leg and whole-trade net peaks are separate original receipts, including historical quantity and realized cash. Policy prices are normalized cash references, not physical token prices. The shared actual exit engine receives checked whole-trade net protection context.

A valuation may create an intent but never fills it with the already-received valuation quote. A separate subsequent exact-size quote is required; the existing original intent/start/receipt chronology and copy-on-write fill guards remain active.

Original cash valuation, remaining peak, total net peak and pre-await quote start bind to the existing intent receipt. Public financial inputs are rechecked at fill and terminal replay without refreshing their original clocks.

Per-arm original cash coverage and historical receipt integrity are required by cohort selection and manifest consumption. A shared market heartbeat, receiptless spot-only legacy cohort, scalar FX or fabricated zero return cannot certify financial policy acceptance. Existing data/intakes/manifests are not rewritten.

coverage: uncapped exact cash and residual position
